findings.title: Raced winners still lack exact persisted closure and zero-effects assertions
findings.detail: The strengthened duplicate test now proves one S21 plus the expected S22 count, one S23, unchanged existing history, and byte-identical retries. However, newly raced rows are only counted and cached for subsequent equality. Their exact S22 semantic keys and FACT/FACTSET/POLICY/PROGRAM references, S21 source/provenance/basis, and S23 candidate hashes/roles/artifact closure are not independently asserted. assert_prepared_rows is called by pipeline for setup results but is never called for duplicate_record, duplicate_projection, duplicate_request or the raced winner. Completion preserves its prior candidate bytes without independently verifying that candidate. The race loop also lacks a before/after S01/receipt/event/outbox snapshot: its final assertion covers only authority table counts at indexes 5:10. Thus the prior duplicate-closure finding remains incompletely closed despite all reruns passing.
findings.required_change: For each raced result independently assert the exact persisted projection/dependency/build closure and hashes against its actual source and request, retaining existing cardinality and old-history comparisons. Assert complete unchanged S01/receipt/event/outbox and authority rows across each preparation race, capturing baselines after intentional source seal/setup effects. Any follow-on build completion used for the proof must follow verification that the raced BUILDING candidate stayed frozen. Rerun all required checks and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews.
